entries.summary: Keep linked branches and draft pull requests in Active.
entries.body: Development now becomes Active as soon as its linked branch is verified. A draft pull request remains a distinct Active step, Review begins only when the pull request is ready, and Project Space no longer creates an empty commit just to open a pull request.
testing: Open task #437 and confirm it appears under Active as Active · Branch, offers Start Codex, and does not show a missing-Draft warning.
Choose Open Draft PR after development starts and confirm the task remains Active but changes visibly to Active · Draft PR.
Mark the draft ready and confirm the task moves to Review, while completed tasks remain unchanged.
Switch to the Phone viewport and confirm the Active label and primary action remain readable without clipping or overlap.

entries.summary: Start development with a verified draft pull request.
entries.body: Starting an issue now creates or reuses its linked branch and opens a verified draft pull request in one flow. Partial or unsafe GitHub states remain blocked with a clear recovery action, and coding tools unlock only after the pull request is confirmed.
testing: Open the fresh Backlog task, choose Start development, and confirm its branch and draft pull request appear before Start Codex becomes available.
Open the branch-only recovery task, choose Finish setup, and confirm it reuses the branch, creates the missing draft pull request, and then enables Start Codex.
Switch the prototype to the Phone viewport and confirm both flows remain readable without clipped or overlapping actions.

entries.summary: Start and reopen exact issue and pull request prototypes.
entries.body: Issue and pull request views now preserve the exact repository, revision, project, machine, task, worktree, and surface while starting, reopening, and returning from a prototype.
testing: Open this Change and confirm the native launch view shows the exact issue, pull request, full head revision, project, machine, task, worktree, and surface identity.
Exercise ready, stale, unavailable, stopped, start, retry, open, and return actions, then confirm deployed mode remains read-only without machine, task, or worktree access.

entries.summary: Preview the verified branch head against the default branch.
entries.body: The issue Development session now shows a compact Git graph beside the verified pull request or branch head, including whether it is current, ahead, behind, or diverged. Behind and diverged states are clearly marked as requiring action.
testing: Open an issue with a verified pull request head and confirm the status and compact graph agree with the default branch comparison.
Check the preview at desktop and narrow widths, then use the History action to open the full graph focused on both branches.

entries.summary: Choose every pull request prototype from its changelog.
entries.body: The exact-source pull request changelog now presents each testable Change separately with its own summary, guidance, surface, and direct prototype action.
testing: Open the PR #396 changelog and confirm both testable Changes are listed independently.
Open this desktop prototype, return with the Changelog action, and choose the other Change.

entries.summary: Keep missing prototype choices from opening unrelated fixtures.
entries.body: Prototype routes now resolve the selected Change through exact changelog metadata and show an unavailable state when a Change or internal scenario is missing or unknown.
testing: Open this mobile prototype and confirm the selected Change remains tied to PR #396 and its exact head revision.
Remove or replace the Change identifier in the review URL and confirm unrelated fixture content does not open.

entries.summary: Add canonical changelog and release notes to Project Docs.
entries.body: Project Docs now provide one changelog source with Unreleased and published-version groups plus exact pull request and version filters.
testing: Open the complete changelog and confirm Unreleased appears before published versions.
Try valid, missing, malformed, and contradictory pull request and version filters.

entries.summary: Show exact-source changelog guidance for pull request previews.
entries.body: Pull request previews can present the changes and concrete testing guidance documented in the same repository revision that produced the preview.
testing: Open a pull request Preview and confirm the changelog notice appears once for that exact revision.
Follow the notice link and confirm the same Preview host opens Docs filtered to that pull request.

entries.summary: Show the deployed Docs version and return path.
entries.body: The Docs sidebar now identifies the verified Project Space version and source revision, then returns to the same pull request Preview or production host.
testing: Open Docs from the pull request Preview and confirm the sidebar shows PR #361, the deployed version, and the exact short revision.
Use the sidebar return link and confirm it opens the same Preview host; on production Docs it should return to Project Space.
